method: No fitted policy or discriminator. For each query window, compare the z-scored 22D motion to 40 consecutive phase templates (one cycle) in each allowed reference clip, using mean squared distance, then use the four nearest distinct clips weighted by inverse squared distance to predict the two achieved release cruise means. The 41-frame stationary clip is verified constant and repeated for phase count balance. No command or absolute phase enters the matching metric. Standardization uses only allowed gallery clips. All windows of a held-out clip are excluded from its gallery. Five deterministic grid folds, followed by a harder split holding both pure vx and pure wz axes out at once. Window 1, 10 and 40 use the same end timesteps. Native data use the full expert gallery, test every seventh stable window and compare per-environment averaged estimates to observed final-six-second means. This experiment only checks correlations on one generator and one checkpoint; it does not reconstruct instantaneous expert root velocity.
